#!/bin/bash

# PropScan Simple Installation Script (No pip required)

set -e

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

print_status() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

check_python() {
    print_status "Checking Python 3..."
    
    if ! command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
        print_error "Python 3 is required but not installed."
        exit 1
    fi
    
    print_success "Python 3 found: $(python3 --version)"
}

install_dependencies() {
    print_status "Installing Python dependencies..."
    
    # Install dependencies using python3 -m pip (works even without pip command)
    python3 -m pip install --user click tabulate colorama
    
    print_success "Dependencies installed!"
}

install_propscan() {
    print_status "Installing PropScan..."
    
    # Create local bin directory if it doesn't exist
    mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
    
    # Copy the propscan script to local bin
    cat > "$HOME/.local/bin/propscan" << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3

import sys
import os

# Add the propscan source directory to Python path
propscan_dir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'propscan', 'src')
sys.path.insert(0, propscan_dir)

from propscan.cli import main

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
    
    chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/propscan"
    
    # Copy source files to ~/.local/share/propscan
    INSTALL_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/propscan"
    mkdir -p "$INSTALL_DIR"
    cp -r src/* "$INSTALL_DIR/"
    
    print_success "PropScan installed to $HOME/.local/bin/propscan"
}

setup_path() {
    print_status "Setting up PATH..."
    
    # Check if ~/.local/bin is in PATH
    if [[ ":$PATH:" != *":$HOME/.local/bin:"* ]]; then
        print_warning "~/.local/bin is not in your PATH"
        print_status "Adding to ~/.bashrc..."
        
        echo '' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
        echo '# Added by PropScan installer' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
        echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
        
        print_success "Added ~/.local/bin to PATH in ~/.bashrc"
        print_status "Please run: source ~/.bashrc"
    else
        print_success "PATH is already configured"
    fi
}

create_desktop_entry() {
    print_status "Creating desktop entry..."
    
    LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/applications"
    mkdir -p "$LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR"
    
    cat > "$LOCAL_DESKTOP_DIR/propscan.desktop" << EOF
[Desktop Entry]
Version=1.0
Type=Application
Name=PropScan
Comment=Scan for proprietary software on Linux systems
Exec=$HOME/.local/bin/propscan
Icon=security-high
Terminal=true
Categories=System;Security;
Keywords=proprietary;software;scan;package;manager;
EOF
    
    print_success "Desktop entry created."
}

show_usage() {
    print_success "Installation completed!"
    echo
    print_status "Usage examples:"
    echo "  propscan                    # Scan all package managers"
    echo "  propscan -m flatpak         # Scan only Flatpak"
    echo "  propscan -f json            # Output as JSON"
    echo "  propscan --list-managers    # List available package managers"
    echo "  propscan --help             # Show help"
    echo
    print_status "If 'propscan' command is not found, run:"
    echo "  source ~/.bashrc"
    echo "  # or"
    echo "  export PATH=\"\$HOME/.local/bin:\$PATH\""
    echo
}

main() {
    echo "PropScan Simple Installation Script"
    echo "==================================="
    echo
    
    check_python
    install_dependencies
    install_propscan
    setup_path
    create_desktop_entry
    show_usage
}

main "$@"
